pages.text: $(bold)A critical difference from vanilla:$(bold)$(br2)The $(bold)Nether is Tier 3$(/bold) content. The $(bold)End is Tier 4$(/bold) content.$(br2)Nether portals require a Tier 3 progression token to activate. End portals require a stabilized Eye of Ender recipe gated to Tier 4. This is intentional — both dimensions are significantly more dangerous than their vanilla equivalents in this pack.

$(bold)Tier 2 Dimensions$(/bold)$(br2)$(bold)Twilight Forest$(/bold) — Dense, dark, ambush-heavy. Bosses guard progression. Home of the first Simply Swords uniques.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies$(/bold) (Everbright + Everdawn) — Elemental combat. Mobs deal elemental damage that bypasses standard armor.$(br2)$(bold)The Aether$(/bold) — Aerial warfare. Vertical combat, thin platforms, falling is lethal. Ranged builds shine here.

$(bold)Tier 3 Dimensions$(/bold)$(br2)$(bold)The Undergarden$(/bold) — Toxic attrition. Constant poison pressure, environmental hazards. Survival builds matter.$(br2)$(bold)Deeper and Darker$(/bold) — Horror survival. Noise attracts mobs. Sculk mechanics. Stealth has value here.$(br2)$(bold)The Nether$(/bold) — Relentless aggression. Everything is permanently aggro. Piglins hunt in packs.$(br2)$(bold)The Abyss: The Other Side$(/bold) — Optional Tier 3 dimension.

$(bold)Tier 4 Dimensions$(/bold)$(br2)$(bold)Deep Aether$(/bold) — Ascension trial. Combines aerial combat with elite mob AI. Celestial Events every 20 minutes empower all mobs.$(br2)$(bold)The End$(/bold) — Three escalating zones: Outer Islands → Deep End / End Cities → Dragon's Domain. Difficulty increases sharply between zones. The End is designed to kill you. $(italic)Prepare accordingly.$(/italic)
